title: Project Northstar — Week 3 Interim Steering Review
subtitle: Choose a direction for evidence mobilization; do not authorize execution

metadata.status: Analyst proposal; design and evidence mobilization only

slides.title: Advance federated design—not execution
slides.subtitle: Advance the federated direction · retain local stabilization · hold global coordination
slides.body: Decision today: assign evidence owners and a 90-day mobilization timebox. No production change, cash movement, closure, labor action, benefit, or spend.
slides.footer: $1.0–$1.5m ceiling only—not cost, budget, or spend authority.
slides.notes: Lead with the decision. Federated coordination is the preferred design direction, not execution approval. Advance means assign owners and close evidence gaps; it does not mean launch either pilot. Retain local stabilization as the controlled fallback and hold global coordination until the critical gates close. The $1.0–$1.5m figure is only an authorization ceiling. Provenance: deliverables/working/week_3/W3_strategic_options.md; W3_future_state_operating_model.md; W3_business_case.md. Evidence labels: ACG-DATA for the ceiling; ANALYST-JUDGMENT for the recommendation.

slides.title: The evidence points to concentrated friction, not a proven benefit
slides.subtitle: Week 2 readouts define where to investigate—and where inference must stop

tables.title: Diagnostic readout
footnotes: Reporting-date delay is a proxy; association is not causation.

slides.interpretation: The next decision is how to close evidence gaps safely—not how much value to book.
slides.notes: The visibility analysis covers 55 accounts and 9,955 account-days from January through June 2026. The delay measure is a reporting-date proxy because receipt timestamps and approved cutoffs are absent. The $38.13m figure is the 30 June 14-day screen; $35m passes 138 of 168 complete windows, but no account-level mobility certification exists. The payment evidence is limited to the supplied 7,600-record extract. Manual touch and cross-border status are associated with friction; they are not proven causes. Do not add the independent repair-hour sources. slides.title: Federated leads at 87—subject to seven open gates
slides.subtitle: Directional option score; not confidence, value, or execution readiness
slides.caption: Advance federated detailed design; retain local fallback; hold global pending evidence.
slides.notes: The scores are ordinal analyst judgments, not confidence scores, value estimates, or approval readiness. The weights were fixed before scoring and sum to 100%. Federated leads the base, controls-first, speed-first, scale/value-first, and local-autonomy-first cases. This supports choosing a learning direction but cannot offset a failed gate. The seven gates are data/ownership, legal/local rights, controls/cyber, service/peak continuity, resilience/rollback, affordability/staging, and benefit recognition. Provenance: deliverables/working/week_3/W3_strategic_options.md; data/processed/W3_option_summary.csv; W3_option_weighted_scores.csv; W3_option_sensitivity.csv; src/week3_strategy.py; tests/test_week3_strategy.py.

slides.title: One global spine can preserve local rights while tightening the decision chain
slides.subtitle: Common standards and evidence; governed regional/local validation and execution
rows: Block unsafe action; use emergency right
slides.caption: This is a decision-rights model—not a platform, bank, vendor, or final-architecture selection.
sources: W3 Future-State Process Map and RACI
slides.notes: The proposed federated model creates one governed daily decision chain while preserving explicit local rights. Group Treasury owns the common data/control spine and enterprise decisions. Regional and local teams validate restrictions and operating needs, protect payroll/tax/refunds/critical suppliers, challenge unsafe action, and use an approved contingency route. Shared Services operates standardized payment steps. IT/Data/Cyber enables source integrity, access, resilience, and rollback. Management owns controls; Internal Audit is consulted. Provenance: deliverables/working/week_3/W3_future_state_operating_model.md; W3_future_state_process_map_and_RACI.md; W3_control_inventory.csv.

slides.subtitle: The cohort tests data reliability; it does not test or value mobility

tables.title: Scope and safeguards
rows: Full source, cutoff, owner, and reconciliation contract first
Read-only shadow; enhanced review or substitution

tables.title: Later operating-test gates
rows: Rollback rehearsed at or below 4 hours

slides.interpretation: No liquidity, borrowing, cash-release, fee, or capacity KPI is an acceptance measure.
slides.notes: The ten accounts are a reproducible coverage-constrained design, not a launch-ready or representative sample. All ten require base readiness/control review. AC0040 alone requires enhanced review and can remain only in read-only shadow observation subject to owner approval. The goal is to replace the reporting-date proxy with governed receipt timestamps, cutoffs, and reconciliation. Four compliant weeks would complete the later technical test, but not authorize movement, value, procurement, or scale. slides.title: Payment v3 uses 120 paired reviews to diagnose causes
slides.subtitle: Four mutually exclusive strata; transparent issue modes and matching deviations

tables.title: Frame readout
rows: Purposive diagnosis; no prevalence or benefit

slides.interpretation: Choose an intervention only after evidence-based root-cause coding and a comparable baseline.
slides.notes: The four strata are manual-only, manual plus cross-border wire, cross-border-wire-only, and neither. They are mutually exclusive, so overlapping totals are never added. Rank issue modes separately, then match controls without replacement on payment type, region, month, and amount band where feasible. This is purposive case-control diagnosis, not a powered prevalence sample, enterprise extrapolation, or benefit sample. No root cause is established because required source documents, criticality, reason codes, and event sequences are absent. Provenance: deliverables/working/week_3/W3_payment_pilot_charter.md; data/processed/W3_payment_sample_frame.csv; W3_pilot_model_controls.csv; src/week3_pilot_design.py; tests/test_week3_pilot_design.py.

slides.title: Four value ledgers stay separate; recognized value remains zero
slides.subtitle: Diagnostic quantities are not benefits and cannot be added
slides.caption: Actual cost, ROI, NPV, payback, and funding recommendation are unavailable.
slides.notes: The scenarios are diagnostic cases, not benefits. The downside $3,900 is independently 50% of the $7,800 portfolio sensitivity; it is not the fee total for a selected two-account cohort. Any two evidenced candidates could total $1,800–$6,000. Capacity stays in hours and is not converted to headcount or P&L. Risk exposure is unknown; $0 refers only to the present recognized-value ledger entry, not zero risk. CR01–CR10 are open, so no return or funding calculation is available. Provenance: deliverables/working/week_3/W3_business_case.md; W3_assumptions_register.csv; data/processed/W3_business_case_scenarios.csv; W3_business_case_value_ledger.csv; W3_cost_evidence_requirements.csv.

slides.title: The downside preserves the direction, while ownership and affordability can force a switch
slides.subtitle: Falsification before commitment

left.title: Direction survives
body: Federated still supports common ownership, controls, local rights, and reversible learning
The same evidence packages remain necessary at lower diagnostic quantities

right.title: Direction switches
body: Use local stabilization if ownership, minimum integration readiness, or affordability fails
Reconsider global only after legal/local, architecture, resilience, cost, mobility, and rollback close
Remove or redesign any option that fails a critical gate

slides.verdict: The recommendation survives only as a conditional design direction; validated value remains $0 and cost remains unavailable.
slides.notes: This is the falsification slide. The recommendation survives smaller diagnostic hypotheses because the option score does not include those scenario values. It does not survive failure of common ownership, integration readiness, affordability, or a critical control. Local stabilization is the immediate fallback and must preserve a minimum governed group feed. Global coordination is not an automatic next phase; it must earn reconsideration through materially stronger evidence and a separate decision. Provenance: deliverables/working/week_3/W3_business_case.md; W3_strategic_options.md; data/processed/W3_business_case_scenarios.csv; W3_option_sensitivity.csv.

slides.title: Five owner-led evidence packages now gate launch and funding
slides.subtitle: Model controls can pass while client evidence remains open
rows: Population, source, cutoff, definition, lineage, owner
Authorization, SoD, access, audit, duplicate, sanctions, test
Critical flows, blackout, monitoring, contingency, ≤4h rollback
slides.caption: MODEL CONTROL PASS validates fail-closed model behavior—not evidence-gate closure.
slides.notes: These packages consolidate the launch and investment gates into named closure work. Data and controls are preconditions. Legal, tax, accounting, cyber, architecture, and service specialists must answer their own questions. Finance owns admission to the value ledger; the CFO/SteerCo separately owns funding and scale. Ten cost requirements and twelve value-gate requirements are defined but incomplete. Automated model controls prevent unsafe calculations; they do not transform assumptions into evidence. slides.summary_callout: Decisions now: endorse direction · assign owners · approve the evidence timebox · reserve all launch, spend, value, and scale decisions.
sources: W3 Business Case and Strategic Options
slides.notes: Close the loop by repeating the opening decision with evidence attached. The 90 days are an analyst-proposed mobilization timebox, not a promise that every gate will close. Time does not override evidence: unfinished packages remain open and force an extension, redesign, or switch to local stabilization. No production pilot begins unless a separate go/no-go is granted after the relevant data, control, service, specialist, cost, and rollback gates are evidenced.
